capabilities: Keeps arrow-key column position across table rows
Splits Chinese and Japanese text into words for motion and selection
Fixes Vim mode motions inside table cells
Adds macOS-style Emacs cursor and editing commands
Binds each behavior as additive, toggleable hotkeys
disambiguation: Not a general hotkey remapper; it only upgrades cursor movement and word editing in the editor, especially inside Markdown tables.
extras: README notes the code and documentation were developed with AI assistance; full documentation is linked separately in English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.
intentEvidence: This plugin exists to close that gap and make Obsidian's Live Preview that much better.
motivation: The author built it to close Live Preview's table-cursor gap: "This plugin exists to close that gap and make Obsidian's Live Preview that much better."
problem: Obsidian's cursor keys, word movement, Home/End and Page Up/Down misbehave inside Live Preview Markdown tables, and Chinese/Japanese text is not split into words.
summary: Cursor-key plugin that makes arrow keys, word motion and Home/End work inside Live Preview Markdown tables, with CJK word splitting and Vim/Emacs support.
